title: A demonstration CAN give semantics -- by induction, not by replay

the_correction_to_r88.r88_said: 'a demonstration gives you procedure and cannot give you semantics; that is structural'
the_correction_to_r88.measured_now: a demonstration gives (chosen element + all candidates + their exposed quantities). The chosen element differs from the others in one direction on one quantity. That IS the predicate.
the_correction_to_r88.mechanism: hypothesis selection over a tiny, exact hypothesis space -- no model, no training, no second example required when one suffices
the_correction_to_r88.so: the claim was too strong. Induction from demonstration is real.

induction_is_real.data_used: data-duration and data-price attributes on MiniWob's buy-ticket elements
induction_is_real.example: chose the shortest flight -> 'pick the element with the minimum duration'

three_limits_measured_not_assumed.detail: data-price and the '$340' in the button text are one quantity; treating them as two produced false AMBIGUOUS in every non-trivial case
three_limits_measured_not_assumed.fix: dedupe on the VALUE ranking, not the name

three_limits_measured_not_assumed.detail: the longest flight is usually also the most expensive, so ONE demo often cannot separate 'max duration' from 'max price'
three_limits_measured_not_assumed.fix: refuse and ask for a second demonstration; induce_from_two resolves it by agreement
three_limits_measured_not_assumed.measured: 3 of 4 demo rounds returned AMBIGUOUS until the two agreeing demos arrived

three_limits_measured_not_assumed.detail: a rule induced from 'longest duration' applied to a 'cheapest cost' goal scored -0.5
three_limits_measured_not_assumed.law: that is a ROUTING error, not a transfer success or a transfer failure -- the rule must be matched to the task that produced it

live_results.rule_recovered_from_two_demos_of_one_tas: pick the element with the minimum duration
live_results.cold_transfer_within_that_task: 1/1 (small n; the task appears randomly, so same-task instances are rare in a short run)

what_this_does_to_the_thesis.learn_once_permanently: STRONGER than r88 concluded. For tasks whose candidates expose comparable quantities, one or two demonstrations yield a RULE that transfers to unseen numbers.
what_this_does_to_the_thesis.still_not_universal: the induction needs the page to EXPOSE the quantity (a data attribute, a numeric text field). If the deciding property is not in the readable state, nothing can be induced from any number of demonstrations.
what_this_does_to_the_thesis.the_sharpened_boundary: a demonstration supplies semantics IFF the evidence for the choice is present in the observed state. That is a checkable precondition, not a philosophical limit.
